aprons.interpolation: Grid row i increases outward; j increases local Z. Cell triangles (i,j),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1) and (i,j),(i+1,j+1),(i,j+1). Linear barycentric surface; take max with final terrain.
Grid row i increases outward; j increases local Z. Cell triangles (i,j),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1) and (i,j),(i+1,j+1),(i,j+1). Linear barycentric surface; take max with final terrain.

Grid row i increases local Z outward; j increases local X. Cell triangles (i,j),(i+1,j),(i+1,j+1) and (i,j),(i+1,j+1),(i,j+1). Linear barycentric surface; inner parabola is existing bridge, outer is measured path plus 3mm.
